messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty (P1) - Queue backlog > 120s for queue 'batch-infer' in us-west-2; autoscaler group 'batch-infer' failing to scale; recent scaling attempts 3x in 10m, pods pending due to quota
alex (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Any known deploys? :eyes:
maya (oncall-2): Not from infra, saw small deploy ~14m ago but unrelated. Seeing 95% cpu on scaler-controller pods and many Pending pods stuck at ContainerCreating.
jordan (sre): Logs show kube-scheduler failing to bind due to nodeGroup quota hitting 90%: "insufficient resources: cpu". Also cloud provider API returning 429 for a subset of calls.
sam (eng-runtime): Hmm, autoscaler metrics show surge from a single customer job spiking queue depth. We have maxReplicas=200 but nodes not provisioning. Trying to exec into scaler-controller logs...
alex (oncall): Running kubectl get pods -n redwood-autoscaler|grep Pending
alex (oncall): ```
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
scaler-controller-0              1/1     Running   0          5d
scaler-controller-1              0/1     CrashLoopBackOff 6   2m
batch-worker-2345                0/1     Pending   0          2m
batch-worker-2346                0/1     Pending   0          1m
```
maya (oncall-2): CrashLoopBackOff stack shows 429s to cloud autoscaling API: "RateLimitExceeded: Too many requests"
jordan (sre): PD escalation will trigger if not acked by senior oncall in 10m. tagging eng-runtime.
sam (eng-runtime): I'm on it. Quick mitigation: set autoscaler API throttling backoff to jittered 1s and temporarily increase node quota for us-west-2 via cloud console. Can someone open a ticket with the request? I'll prepare the patch.
alex (oncall): Opening incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1123 — added logs and current impact. Customer impact: increased tail latency for hosted inference batch endpoints, some tasks queued >2m. Not a full outage but severe degradation.
maya (oncall-2): Creating a temporary scaling-policy override: maxReplicas -> 400 for group 'batch-infer' to allow node provisioning once quota bumped. Applying with kubectl patch now.
sam (eng-runtime): Pushing quick fix to autoscaler to back off on 429s and throttle requester concurrency. Patch diff:
```diff
- backoff_ms: 200
+ backoff_ms: 1000
+ jitter: true
``` 
sam (eng-runtime): Applying configmap update... rolling restart scaler-controller-1.
alex (oncall): manual node increase request sent to cloud infra team (ticket INF-245). ETA ~8-12m.
jordan (sre): Noted external API 429 burst correlated with control-plane mass reconcile. Could be self-induced from simultaneous rollout. Recommend pausIng non-critical rollouts.
maya (oncall-2): I'll pause the batch-infer canary rollout in prod.
incident-bot: PagerDuty status: alex (oncall) acknowledged the incident. PagerDuty: escalation suppressed for now.
sam (eng-runtime): scaler-controller-1 is back to Running.
alex (oncall): New nodes starting to come up, see node-wn-12 provisioning.
alex (oncall): ```kubectl get nodes | grep wn-12
wn-12   Ready   <labels>   23s
``` 
maya (oncall-2): Pods are transitioning to Running. backlog depth dropping from 240 to 60 in metrics dashboard.
jordan (sre): Customer-facing summary draft for status page: "We experienced increased queuing for batch inference in us-west-2 due to autoscaler API rate limits preventing timely node provisioning. Engineering applied a throttling fix and requested temporary quota increase; backlog is clearing and latency is improving. No data loss observed." Thoughts?
sam (eng-runtime): Looks good. Add note: "Mitigation applied: autoscaler backoff increased, temporary maxReplicas lift, and manual quota bump." 
alex (oncall): Sending update to #customer-impact and paging SRE manager for post-incident analysis. :email:
maya (oncall-2): Closing steps: schedule follow-up with cloud infra to raise long-term quota and add exponential backoff to autoscaler. Also add flux to not trigger simultaneous reconcile during high traffic.
alex (oncall): Marking incident P1->P2 for monitoring. Will update INC-1123 timeline and handoff to daytime oncall @maya in 10m.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by alex (oncall). Next escalation in 30m if not resolved.
incident-bot: Incident closed (automated) - backlog under threshold for 15m. Incident thread archived.
